svg.title: Vale promises Riju a direct permanent systems appointment if he delivers honestly.
svg.desc: Vale's pristine silver tablet and Riju's worn canvas satchel frame their formal exchange. Vale says the permanent systems appointment will be Riju's after successful honest delivery; Riju answers evenly while gripping the strap.
svg.text: Page 21, panel 2 · Eye-level two-shot across the end of the conference table

text.tspan: Vale confirms that successful honest delivery will
give Riju the direct permanent systems appointment.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
